conf.description: Proofpoint Email Security tap-messages / api-pull: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: proofpoint / tap-messages / api-pull. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Proofpoint TAP integration (message_blocked / message_delivered data streams)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
